treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Slovenia and the Federal Republic of Germany for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2006, as amended 2011)
eif_quote: FURS "Seznam veljavnih mednarodnih pogodb o izogibanju dvojnega obdavčevanja ... ki se uporabljajo v letu 2026" (Država | Objava | Začetek uporabe KIDO | Združeno besedilo | Začetek uporabe MLI): NEMČIJA | MP, št. 22/06, | 1. 1. 2007 | | |
source_title: Uradni list RS – Mednarodne pogodbe, št. 22/2006 (SI-DE Agreement and Protocol, Slovenian and English texts); Protocol 2011 in MP 14/2011

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: FURS list: NEMČIJA | MP, št. 22/06 | 1. 1. 2007 | (no synthesised text, no MLI start date)

notes: Agreement enters into force on exchange of ratification instruments and has effect for WHT on amounts paid on or after 1 January of the following year (Art. 31(2)(a)); FURS: applied from 1.1.2007, so EIF fell in 2006, but the exact date was not found in the fetched sources (entry_into_force left null). Protocol 2011 (MP 14/11, applied from 30.7.2012) only replaced Art. 26 and Protocol point 5 (exchange of information); Arts. 10-12 unchanged. Protocol point 3: profit-participating dividends/interest (stille Gesellschaft, partiarisches Darlehen, Gewinnobligationen) deductible for the debtor may be taxed at source under domestic law without limit (not modelled). Art. 11(3): interest paid to Governments/central banks/SID-SEC, KfW, DEG and on state-guaranteed export/FDI loans exempt. MLI not applicable (neither State lists the treaty).
unverified: Exact entry-into-force date of the 2006 Agreement (exchange of ratification instruments, 2006)
